metadata.question: Was the mean aerosol optical depth higher over Chengdu than over Suining between 2001 and 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS aerosol optical depth (AOD) data - "MODIS/006/MCD19A2_GRANULES" or "MODIS/061/MCD19A2_GRANULES" for AOD at 550nm - Date: 2001-2023 (MODIS Terra/Aqua available from 2000) - Location: Two cities in Sichuan, China - Chengdu (capital) and Suining (smaller city to the east) 2. Masking strategy: - AOD data typically has QA bands. I should use quality flags to mask poor quality pixels. - Check for valid AOD values (typically 0-5, with values <0 being invalid) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid Zero: AOD can legitimately be very low (clear conditions), so 0-0.1 is valid → compare values → A or B - C1: If no images found for either location - C2: If after masking, no valid pixels remain - C3: If result is None, NaN, or outside valid AOD range (e.g., negative or >5) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const chengdu = ee.Geometry.Point([104.0668, 30.5728]); const suining = ee.Geometry.Point([105.5933, 30.5093]); const startDate = '2001-01-01'; const endDate = '2023-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Using MODIS MCD19A2 (Terra+Aqua combined AOD) let collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD19A2_GRANULES') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('Optical_Depth_047'); // AOD at 470nm (can also use 550nm) // Check if collection has data const collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Total images in collection: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No MODIS AOD data found for 2001-2023."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing function with quality masking function maskAOD(image) { // Optical_Depth_047 scale factor is 0.001 const aod = image.select('Optical_Depth_047').multiply(0.001); // Mask invalid values (negative or unreasonably high) const validMask = aod.gte(0).and(aod.lte(5)); return aod.updateMask(validMask); } const aodCollection = collection.map(maskAOD); // 4. Calculate mean AOD for both locations const buffer = 5000; // 5km buffer around point const chengduRegion = chengdu.buffer(buffer); const suiningRegion = suining.buffer(buffer); // Reduce collection to mean image const meanAOD = aodCollection.mean(); // Calculate statistics for Chengdu const chengduStats = meanAOD.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: chengduRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const chengduMean = chengduStats.mean; const chengduCount = chengduStats.count; console.log(`Chengdu - Mean AOD: ${chengduMean}, Valid pixels: ${chengduCount}`); // Calculate statistics for Suining const suiningStats = meanAOD.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: suiningRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const suiningMean = suiningStats.mean; const suiningCount = suiningStats.count; console.log(`Suining - Mean AOD: ${suiningMean}, Valid pixels: ${suiningCount}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (chengduCount === 0 || suiningCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after quality masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (chengduMean === null || chengduMean === undefined || suiningMean === null || suiningMean === undefined || isNaN(chengduMean) || isNaN(suiningMean)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (chengduMean < 0 || chengduMean > 5 || suiningMean < 0 || suiningMean > 5) { console.log("AOD values out of valid range."); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`Difference (Chengdu - Suining): ${(chengduMean - suiningMean).toFixed(4)}`); if (chengduMean > suiningMean) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
